newsitem.title: USA: Argosy vice chairman, CEO Long resigns.
newsitem.headline: Argosy vice chairman, CEO Long resigns.

text.p: Argosy Gaming Co said on Tuesday that J. Thomas Long resigned as vice chairman, chief executive officer, general counsel and a member of the company's board of directors.
Long asked that he be released from his duties to pursue his business opportunities in commercial banking, Argosy said in a statement.
Long agreed to remain as a consultant to the company through 1999.

Argosy said its directors appointed current board member George Bristol as interim chief executive officer. Bristol is president of GLB Inc, a consulting firm located in Austin, Texas. Directors also appointed James Richmond as interim general counsel. Richmond is a senior partner in the law firm of Ungaretti & Harris located in Chicago.
"We are very sorry to see Tom leave the company. He has been instrumental to our company's success," said William Cellini, Argosy chairman, in a statement.
Argosy develops, owns and operates riverboat casinos and entertainment facilities in the midwestern and south United States.
Shares of Argosy closed at 4-3/8 yesterday.
